say:12:1041502510:1.text: Hmm, in retrospect, I did put in a lot of thought when I chose vines as the base component...
say:12:1041502510:1.source_cn: 唔，这样回头看看，当时先选中了藤蔓作为基础材料，我也是...

say:13:1041502511:1.text: Yeah, Damian, I think the prosthetics are perfect as they are now. No need to change anything.
say:13:1041502511:1.source_cn: 是啊，达米安，我感觉如今的义肢已经很完美了，没有必要再...

say:14:1041502512:1.text: No, no, Mr. Korin, the spirit of innovation must not become stagnant!
say:14:1041502512:1.source_cn: 不不不，科林大叔！发明精神绝对不能固步不前！！

say:15:1041502513:1.text: What's acceptable now doesn't mean it will be in the future!
say:15:1041502513:1.source_cn: 现在好用不代表将来好用，现在不会坏不代表十年后不会坏！

say:16:1041502514:1.text: ...Well, I might not even last ten years myself, let alone the prosthetics...
say:16:1041502514:1.source_cn: ……我是觉得，十年别说是义肢的寿命，作为我的寿命都绰绰...

say:17:1041502515:1.text: Oops, sorry, we soldiers like to crack jokes about life and death a lot, not to mention I am indeed old...
say:17:1041502515:1.source_cn: 啊哈哈哈哈，抱歉。我们常上战场的，生生死死的玩笑一直都...

say:18:1041502516:1.text: However, speaking from the heart, I believe the prosthetics now are good enough for me and might even benefit my war buddies...
say:18:1041502516:1.source_cn: 不过，发自内心地说，我觉得现在的义肢真的足够覆盖我使用...

say:19:1041502517:1.text: No, there aren't enough combat features!
say:19:1041502517:1.source_cn: 不行！我感觉对于作战来说，功能实在太少了！！！

say:20:1041502518:1.text: Yes! My idea is to have prosthetics that mirror the firearms in Lightbearer.
say:20:1041502518:1.source_cn: 是的！我目前的预想是，希望义肢能够有模仿耀光那边的枪械...

say:21:1041502519:1.text: Mr. Korin's weapon is knocked away, only for his arm to suddenly transform and... blam! Totally unexpected!
say:21:1041502519:1.source_cn: 手中的冷兵器被人击飞，这时，唰！科林大叔的手臂变形！砰...

say:22:1041502520:1.text: ...I'm sorry, Damian. I appreciate the thought very much, but that kind of feature... Well...
say:22:1041502520:1.source_cn: ……抱、抱歉，达米安，虽然很感激你的心意，但这个功能，呃……

say:23:1041502521:1.text: It's a bit too unusual... no, too advanced for me...
say:23:1041502521:1.source_cn: 对我来说有点太出其不意……不是，太超前了……

say:24:1041502522:1.text: So, regrettably, allow me to reject...
say:24:1041502522:1.source_cn: 所以，很遗憾，请允许我拒绝……

say:26:1041502509:1.text: Yeah, Mr. Korin can't lift with his arms now and has to rely on his chest and back. Heavy arms are beyond inconvenient.
say:26:1041502509:1.source_cn: 是的，科林大叔的双臂都无法使用了，只能靠胸背发力，太沉...

say:27:1041502504:1.text: Well, I'm not saying I'm not good with machinery. Just look at my little vehicle and aircraft...
say:27:1041502504:1.source_cn: 唔，我也不是说不擅长机械，你看我的小车和飞机……
